source: DR 08 T6-4 — two self-occupied houses, the aggregate cap
_source: "Two self-occupied houses, interest ₹1,80,000 and ₹1,50,000, both qualifying for the ₹2,00,000 limb." "min(1,80,000, 2,00,000) = 1,80,000; min(1,50,000, 2,00,000) = 1,50,000; sum = 3,30,000"; "HP-CAP-SELFOCC-003 … min(3,30,000 , 2,00,000) = 2,00,000"; "Expected: ₹2,00,000, not ₹3,30,000." So the head is −₹2,00,000, set off within the s.109(1)(b) ₹2,00,000. Old regime (the DR 08 matrix column). INFERENCE, not DR 08's: no pre-construction interest; each house acquired in the year run and the capital borrowed the year before, the lender's certificate held, so each qualifies for the ₹2,00,000 limb as the case says. INFERENCE, not DR 08's (D-217 C5): the other-sources deposit interest of ₹3,00,000 that absorbs the loss — DR 08 states no income under another head, and any amount of ₹2,00,000 or more gives the same set-off.
